info.title: SecureVOTE API
info.description: Educational/research prototype of an embedded electronic-voting and election-integrity pipeline. This is NOT production election infrastructure. See /docs for the interactive API explorer.

post.description: Authenticate and receive a JWT access token.
Create a new election. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: Get election details with candidates and device count.

post.description: Add candidates to an election. Requires ADMIN role.

schema.title: Response Add Candidates Api Elections  Election Id  Candidates Post
Response Get Candidates Api Elections  Election Id  Candidates Get

patch.description: Change election state. Enforces strict state machine transitions. Requires ADMIN role.

post.description: Authorize a voting session. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: List all voting sessions for an election. Requires ADMIN or AUDITOR role.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Elections  Election Id  Sessions Get

post.description:
Cast a vote. Authenticated by session_token, not JWT.

The session_token serves as the simulated credential/session
authorization for this educational prototype.
Register a device for an election. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: List all devices for an election.

schema.title: Response List Devices Api Elections  Election Id  Devices Get

patch.description: Update device status. Requires ADMIN role.
